Maya (CSM): Quick sync re: Linden Health onboarding 4dd - worried the onboarding credit model could create renewal friction. Can we confirm external wording + cap?
Diego (Ops): I ran a 30m sim: two short latency spikes from model import + one 3m outage from misconfigured autoscaler. Numbers look noisy.
Sam (Support): I'll draft a short customer note that shows the math and next steps.
Priya (Finance): Finance prefers a predictable cap for onboarding. Proposal: default 15% per 7 days, enterprise can opt-out via addendum.
Aisha (Renewals): Renewal ask: if projected credits >10% over 90d, flag for exec review and offer a call.
Diego (Ops): Sim summary:
```
Event A: 3m outage -> uptime calc -> credit 8%
Event B: p95 jump 800ms for 10m -> latency credit 5%
Stacked (no cap): 13%
With proposed cap 15%/7d -> final credit 13%
```
Maya (CSM): Good. Sam, please avoid past-tense "we applied" until Finance confirms. Use "we will apply". Also add a one-line mitigation: stagger imports or request pre-warm.
Sam (Support): Draft v1: "During onboarding we observed brief latency events and one short outage. We will assess your onboarding window against the SLA and apply any eligible service credits. For questions or a walkthrough, schedule time with your CSM"
Priya (Finance): Ack on phrasing. I'll confirm the cap number by EOD.
Aisha (Renewals): I'll update the renewal playbook to surface the >10% signal and include a script for CSMs.
eng-alert-bot: infra snapshot attached (3409876668) :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Action items: Sam publish external note + calc link, Diego attach sim logs, Priya confirm cap, Aisha update playbook. I'll consolidate into onboarding playbook when done.
